kind: M2-B1 CUDA bounded original-library source audit; not full product coverage

first_binding.storage: plain F32/F16/BF16; nonempty dense rank0..8 or element-aligned rank<=4 strides
first_binding.native_execution: Original ggml CUDA kernels and graph backend; no new kernel, CPU model fallback, pin or resource-patch change
first_binding.lifetime: existing independent backend/streams/buffers/events per invocation; bind producer roots through reshape views, mark published roots and views; cold scalar uploads; account variadic ports in metadata capacity
first_binding.numeric_note: Original CUDA LayerNorm uses E[x*x]-E[x]*E[x]. Adapter composes original mean/sub/sqr/mean/add/sqrt/div to express centered variance; shifted-input oracle declared. No timing or old-HYLE comparison.

capacity_review: element count <= (INT32_MAX-1024)/sizeof(float), required bytes and strides <= INT32_MAX
original CUDA cpy scalar transpose falls back to generic 1D when grid_y/grid_z exceed USHRT_MAX; no arbitrary descriptor rank-dependent launch restriction added
dense matrix normalization and row reduction have singleton channel/sample dimensions; original binbcast handles broadcast indices; concat uses its original contiguous flattened kernel
fixed metadata arena reserves count*4 + nodes*64 + variadic concat ports*4 + 16 with prechecked overflow
remaining: empty tensor and nonrepresentable high-rank/odd-byte-stride paths
other storage types and checked index cast
dynamic Gather/Scatter, checked Scan and stable TopK
Select/min/max, stable activation/gates, full masked Softmax/LogSoftmax qualification
cross-environment delivery, sanitizer and immutable-candidate performance gates
softmax_contract_correction: Public no-valid-row result is NaN, not zero; CPU Release numeric rejection corrected in fd37c586. Native Debug and full-domain qualification remain distinct. No oneDNN Q2 recovery.
